_comment: The deployed Vercel function. Selected with APP_ENV=dev.
Two differences from local.json carry all the weight:
1. EMBEDDER=gemini. fastembed ships ~200MB of onnxruntime plus a model
download, which does not belong in a serverless bundle. Gemini is an
HTTP call, so the deployed function stays small.
2. STORE_BACKEND=supabase. The deployed app is stateless; the index lives
in Postgres rather than being rebuilt from disk on every cold start.
NO SECRETS IN THIS FILE. GROQ_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, SUPABASE_* and
CLOUDINARY_* are set in the Vercel dashboard as environment variables.
